_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description.

projects.description: Real-time road damage and pothole detection from live camera or uploaded video, paired with a simulated LoRa-style V2V hazard-alert layer built to later swap in real hardware.
AI-powered loan eligibility predictor with approval odds, bank recommendations, an EMI simulator and an AI coach, wrapped in a glassmorphism UI.
Simplifies contracts and extracts key clauses from legal documents, with LLM- and OCR-backed compliance checks.
HireLadder - a Naukri/Indeed-style job portal front end, with Chart.js analytics dashboards and FullCalendar scheduling.
